assertions.subject: early_blight
assertions.value: Remove infected lower leaves, improve airflow, avoid overhead watering, rotate crops; use locally approved fungicide if needed.

assertions.subject: early_blight
assertions.value: Avoid wetting foliage and remove crop debris.

assertions.subject: late_blight
assertions.value: Remove and destroy infected plants, avoid handling wet plants, improve airflow, and seek local extension guidance promptly.

assertions.subject: late_blight
assertions.value: Use disease-free transplants and avoid prolonged leaf wetness.

assertions.subject: septoria_leaf_spot
assertions.value: Remove affected leaves, mulch soil to reduce splash, rotate crops, and keep foliage dry.

assertions.subject: septoria_leaf_spot
assertions.value: Rotate crops and remove infected plant debris.

assertions.subject: bacterial_spot
assertions.value: Avoid working with wet plants, remove heavily affected debris, use clean seed/transplants, and consult local guidance.

assertions.subject: bacterial_spot
assertions.value: Use pathogen-free seed and avoid overhead irrigation.

assertions.subject: bacterial_wilt
assertions.value: Remove affected plants with roots; improve drainage and use resistant varieties where available.

assertions.subject: bacterial_wilt
assertions.value: Use clean transplants and rotate with non-host crops.

assertions.subject: fusarium_wilt
assertions.value: Remove affected plants, use resistant cultivars, and avoid moving contaminated soil.

assertions.subject: fusarium_wilt
assertions.value: Choose resistant varieties and maintain clean tools.

assertions.subject: verticillium_wilt
assertions.value: Use resistant varieties, rotate with non-host crops, and remove severely affected plants.

assertions.subject: verticillium_wilt
assertions.value: Use clean planting material and long rotations where practical.

assertions.subject: powdery_mildew
assertions.value: white patches on upper leaf surface

assertions.subject: powdery_mildew
assertions.value: Remove severely affected leaves, improve airflow, and use locally approved treatments according to label.

assertions.subject: powdery_mildew
assertions.value: Space plants well and monitor foliage regularly.

assertions.subject: gray_mold
assertions.value: Remove infected plant parts, reduce humidity, improve ventilation, and avoid wounds.

assertions.subject: gray_mold
assertions.value: Provide good ventilation and remove senescent plant material.

assertions.subject: anthracnose
assertions.value: Harvest promptly, remove infected fruit, avoid overhead watering, and rotate crops.

assertions.subject: anthracnose
assertions.value: Use clean seed/transplants and avoid fruit contact with soil.

assertions.subject: target_spot
assertions.value: Remove affected foliage, improve airflow, reduce leaf wetness, and seek local crop-protection advice.

assertions.subject: target_spot
assertions.value: Rotate crops and reduce prolonged leaf wetness.

assertions.subject: tomato_mosaic_virus
assertions.value: mosaic light and dark green leaves

assertions.subject: tomato_mosaic_virus
assertions.value: Remove infected plants, disinfect tools and hands, and control weeds that may host the virus.

assertions.subject: tomato_mosaic_virus
assertions.value: Use certified seed and sanitize tools between plants.

assertions.subject: tomato_yellow_leaf_curl_virus
assertions.value: Remove severely infected plants and manage whiteflies using integrated pest management.

assertions.subject: tomato_yellow_leaf_curl_virus
assertions.value: Use resistant varieties and insect-proof nursery practices.

assertions.subject: spotted_wilt_virus
assertions.value: Remove infected plants and manage thrips with integrated pest management.

assertions.subject: spotted_wilt_virus
assertions.value: Control thrips and remove weed hosts.

assertions.subject: root_knot_nematode
assertions.value: Remove infected roots, rotate with non-host crops, and seek local nematode management advice.

assertions.subject: root_knot_nematode
assertions.value: Use clean transplants and resistant rootstocks where suitable.

assertions.subject: gray_leaf_spot
assertions.value: Remove infected debris, improve airflow, and avoid overhead irrigation.

assertions.subject: southern_blight
assertions.value: white fungal growth at soil line

assertions.subject: southern_blight
assertions.value: Remove affected plants and surrounding contaminated soil; improve drainage and seek local advice.

assertions.subject: southern_blight
assertions.value: Avoid moving contaminated soil and use crop rotation.

assertions.subject: bacterial_canker
assertions.value: Remove infected plants, disinfect tools, avoid handling wet plants, and use clean seed.

assertions.subject: bacterial_canker
assertions.value: Use certified seed and strict tool sanitation.

assertions.subject: blossom_end_rot
assertions.value: dark sunken patch at blossom end

assertions.subject: blossom_end_rot
assertions.value: Maintain even soil moisture, mulch, and avoid excessive nitrogen; assess soil calcium and pH before amendments.

assertions.subject: blossom_end_rot
assertions.value: Use consistent irrigation and avoid root damage.

assertions.subject: sunscald
assertions.value: pale white patch on exposed fruit

assertions.subject: sunscald
assertions.value: Maintain healthy foliage, avoid excessive pruning, and harvest ripe fruit promptly.

assertions.subject: sunscald
assertions.value: Keep adequate leaf cover and avoid severe pruning.
